_about: The next meeting of the release-sync series, as Fireflies produces it after the call (title, summary, transcript, action items). Imported when the meeting ends in the demo. Days are relative to the import date.
title: Analytics Dashboard Release · Release Check-in

overview: Fred's status at the start: the filters-panel UI fixes are done; regression and load testing are still open.
The release stays on track. The team agreed it needs a rollback runbook and release-day monitoring alerts before go-live.
Neha will re-run the tablet regression on the final build once the monitoring alerts are in place.
James will send the customer announcement email the day before release.
Booking the war room for release day was raised but no one took it.

sentences.text: Thanks Fred for the status. The UI fixes are done, so let us close the gaps before release.
We have no alerts for the new dashboard yet. I will set up the release-day monitoring alerts <mark>by tomorrow</mark>.
If load testing shows problems we need a way back. I will write the rollback runbook <mark>in 2 days</mark>.
Once Arjun's alerts are live, I will re-run the tablet regression on the final build <mark>in 3 days</mark>.
Customers should hear from us first. I will send the release announcement email <mark>in 4 days</mark>, the day before release.
We also need the war room booked for release day <mark>in 3 days</mark>. Can someone pick that up?
Okay, Fireflies will send everyone their items. Thanks all.

action_items.text: Re-run tablet regression on the final build
Send the release announcement email to customers
Book the war room for release day
